question: places inside Torre VTS de Algés
commercial buildings with restaurants
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.names.primary AS building_name, b.subtype
FROM lisbon_buildings b
JOIN lisbon_places p ON ST_Contains(b.geometry, p.geometry)
WHERE b.subtype = 'commercial' AND p.basic_category = 'restaurant';

question: buildings touching schools
places outside buildings
buildings with places
places in buildings taller than 50 m
sql:
SELECT p.id, p.names.primary AS place_name, p.basic_category, b.height
FROM lisbon_places p
JOIN lisbon_buildings b ON ST_Within(p.geometry, b.geometry)
WHERE b.height > 50;
